title: NIST WebBook: Sulfur dioxide is O2S, molecular weight 64.064 amu
summary: The NIST Chemistry WebBook lists Sulfur dioxide as O2S, molecular weight 64.064 amu, CAS 7446-09-5.
body: The NIST Chemistry WebBook entry for Sulfur dioxide, CAS Registry Number 7446-09-5, lists molecular formula O2S and molecular weight 64.064 amu. The same entry's monoisotopic molecular weight is 63.96190024 amu. The IUPAC InChI on the entry is InChI=1S/O2S/c1-3-2. The molecular weight and the monoisotopic mass are two different fields. This card reports the catalog entry. It does not convert either field into a molar mass in grams, and it does not say that every real sample has that weight.
